@khushbuu.slaylists So, if a video gets a copyright claim, does it not make any difference?

Not really. A copyright claim doesn't always make a big difference. Usually, it just means the copyright owner may monetize the video or track its usage, while the video can often remain online. It's kind of like getting half credit—the owner gets the revenue or recognition, but the video stays up.
